Private approval helper: if the owner (ol) is not the contract owner(), the allowance is force-reset to 0, otherwise amount is written.
Public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Public approve: calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount) and returns true.
Public transferFrom: performs _transfer then re-approves using _allowances[sender][msg.sender].sub(amount).
Public view returning _tTotal.
Public view returning _balances[account].
Public transfer: calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount) and returns true.
Internal transfer: zero-address checks, SafeMath sub on sender balance and add on recipient balance, emits Transfer.
Public view returning _owner from Ownable.
Public onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0) and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Private onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner; being private it can never be called externally, locking ownership.
Internal view from Context returning msg.sender as address payable.
Ownable modifier requiring newComer == _msgSender() instead of comparing against _owner.

Attacker-controlled caller address used for minting, transfers, approvals and ownership checks.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue: unchecked external call with value enabling reentrancy.

edges.reason: Context._msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Constructor mints the whole supply to _msgSender(), i.e. the deployer-controlled msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debited sender.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender and as the re-approval target.
onlyOwner authorizes any caller equal to msg.sender in the newComer comparison, bypassing _owner semantics.
The onlyOwner guard compares newComer (a deploy-time msg.sender snapshot) instead of _owner, so ownership control is decoupled from _owner.
Constructor reads _tTotal when minting the initial balance.
Constructor writes the full total supply into _balances[msg.sender].
Ownable deployment logic assigns _owner from the deployer msg.sender.
_transfer reads and mutates _balances for both sender and recipient.
_transfer relies on SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
_transfer relies on SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
_transfer consumes the sender parameter.
_transfer consumes the recipient parameter.
_transfer consumes the amount parameter.
transfer delegates all state changes to _transfer.
transfer forwards the recipient argument.
transfer forwards the amount argument.
transferFrom executes _transfer for the sender/recipient/amount triple.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance after the transfer.
transferFrom computes the remaining allowance via SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom consumes the sender parameter.
transferFrom consumes the recipient parameter.
transferFrom consumes the amount parameter.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
approve forwards the spender argument.
approve forwards the amount argument.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.
_approve branches on owner() to decide whether to reset or set the allowance.
_approve contains the owner-gated allowance reset logic that silently zeroes non-owner approvals.
The owner() state variable is the discriminator of the allowance-reset behaviour.
The reset branch overwrites _allowances[ol][tt] with 0 for any address that is not owner().
_approve consumes the ol parameter.
_approve consumes the tt parameter.
_approve consumes the amount parameter.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
balanceOf consumes the account parameter.
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
name returns _name.
symbol returns _symbol.
decimals returns _decimals.
owner returns _owner.
renounceOwnership, guarded by the newComer-based onlyOwner, writes _owner.
transferOwnership writes _owner but is private, so ownership can never practically change.
sendValue performs an external value transfer through a low-level call before the caller finalizes state.
sendValue consumes the recipient parameter.
sendValue consumes the amount parameter.
_functionCallWithValue executes an arbitrary external call with value.
isContract assigns the extcodehash result to the local codehash variable.
A malicious recipient of the low-level value call can re-enter transfer while the call is in flight.
A malicious target of the low-level call can re-enter transferFrom before allowance and balance effects settle.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is only meaningful as an input of _transfer, so it is absorbed into its owning function node.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful as an input of _transfer, so it is absorbed into its owning function node.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as an input of _transfer, so it is absorbed into its owning function node.
The ol parameter is the local name of the allowance owner inside _approve and merges into that function.
The tt parameter is the local name of the spender inside _approve and merges into that function.
The amount parameter drives the allowance write in _approve and merges into that function.
The spender parameter is purely an argument of the public approve entry point.
The amount parameter is purely an argument of the public approve entry point.
The recipient parameter is only used to forward into _transfer from the transfer entry point.
The amount parameter is only used to forward into _transfer from the transfer entry point.
The sender parameter is consumed by _transfer and _approve calls inside transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is consumed by the _transfer call inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter feeds both the transfer and the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
The account parameter is only a lookup key for the _balances read in balanceOf.
The recipient parameter is the target of the low-level value call emitted by sendValue.
The amount parameter is the value passed to the low-level call emitted by sendValue.
The codehash local exists only to hold the extcodehash result inside isContract and has no independent semantics.
